lessons.text: When an invoice may already be recorded, query the ERP bills endpoint first (e.g. /bills?vendor_id=V003) or use the Payables page; if a bill with the same invoice number exists, do not create a new bill and capture its bill ID/status.

The ERP web session can expire during navigation and redirect to /erp/login?next=/erp; sign in again using the ERP_USER and ERP_PASSWORD secrets, or use the API endpoints directly to avoid UI session loss.

Payments of INR 50,000 or more require Finance Manager approval before scheduling; if the ERP returns 'approval declined (large-payment)' after a scheduling attempt, the decline is final in this environment and cannot be overridden by emailing the Finance Manager.

To schedule payment in the ERP bill detail page, enter the invoice due date in the 'Payment date' field and click the schedule button; if approval is required, do this only after approval is visible/recorded.

AP mailbox search uses /mail?folder=<folder>&q=<query>; the compose form has To, Subject, and Message fields. Send AP confirmations/escalations only to AP lead Priya Nair (priya.nair@kestrel.in), and Finance Manager approval requests to Arjun Mehta (arjun.mehta@kestrel.in).
